title: libpod: fix Batch shallow copy of container state
body:
Batch() was copying the state pointer (newCtr.state = c.state), not the actual state struct. This means mutations inside the batch function affect the original containers state directly, bypassing the intended copy-on-write isolation that Batch is documented to provide.

This fixes the issue by performing a deep copy of the state: newState := *c.state
newCtr.state = &newState

This ensures that any state modifications within the batch function do not leak back to the original container.
